Incident Bot: PAGE fired -> service=\"inference-gateway-prod\" severity=critical incident=PD-78123 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident PD-78123 triggered by metric-threshold (5xx-rate > 3% over 2m). Routing policy: service=inference-gateway-prod -> escalation=platform-team
Alex R: I just woke up to a page. seeing a ton of 502s from edge. any idea which stack?
Maria L: same, getting paged. I'm on mobile, can someone confirm which on-call got this?
Samir P: PagerDuty notif shows platform-team as target but platform-oncall is empty (scheduled hold). weird.
Irene T: checking rotations... one sec.
Ops Rotation: schedule-check: service inference-gateway-prod -> bindings: [platform-oncall, infra-oncall] (priority order: platform, infra)
Irene T: okay there's the problem — both bindings got attached. platform-oncall schedule is paused for today due to maintenance, but the binding didn't remove, so PD still tried platform first and then escalated incorrectly.
Alex R: so page went to people not actually signed in? that's why we had a slow ack. who has access to change routing right now?
Maria L: I can. but we should verify impact first. Samir, do we have customer-facing errors? any frontend SLO alerts?
Samir P: yes Customer Errors dashboard: spike in 502s starting 06:51 UTC. error-rate peaked 8.7% for 6m. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Correlates with deploy? no recent deploys to gateway in last 30m.
Alex R: I'll tail the gateway logs. quick snippet: ```
[06:52:10] upstream_timeout: conn reset
[06:52:11] 502 from model-proxy-12
[06:52:12] kvcache-miss spike
```
Maria L: thanks. looks like model-proxy cluster flapped. but the immediate ops problem is routing — we need infra-oncall to own this now.
Irene T: paging history from PD: initial attempt -> platform-oncall (no ack, paused schedule), then escalation -> platform-manager (also paused), then fallback -> infra-oncall. infra saw the page but with long delay. PD timestamps: 06:51:03 -> 06:58:40 -> 07:00:21
Alex R: we need to shrink that window. I'll do a temporary routing override to point inference-gateway-prod straight at infra-oncall and mute the platform binding. Maria, can you confirm you'll take lead until we stabilize?
Maria L: on it. making the PD override now.
Maria L: command: ```
# pd-cli override-binding --service inference-gateway-prod --remove-binding platform-oncall --add-binding infra-oncall --note "temp override due to paused schedule"
```
PagerDuty Bot: binding-change accepted (change_id=chg-4482). New primary binding: infra-oncall.
Incident Bot: PD-78123 acknowledged by Maria L @ 07:02:05 UTC
Samir P: infra team, if you can check model-proxy autoscaler and recent node churn. I see 3x pod restarts on model-proxy-12 in 5m.
Irene T: digging into rotation config — there is an edge-case in our schedule syncer when a schedule is flagged "paused" but still bound via an override; if an override exists it doesn't auto-unbind. I've filed a quick bug: ROT-2237.
Alex R: mitigation plan: 1) keep infra-oncall primary 2) scale model-proxy cluster + restart proxy pods 3) roll traffic to healthy model-proxies 4) postmortem if root-cause not infra churn
Maria L: I've scaled model-proxy from 6->12 replicas and forced a rolling restart on the 3 failing pods. monitoring now.
Samir P: errors dropping: now 1.2% 502s and trending down. latency back to normal on main routes.
Alex R: good. after stabilization we should revert PD binding and patch the schedule-syncer to auto-remove paused bindings. Irene, please own ROT-2237 and help with patch.
Irene T: ack. urgent fix step: add check in syncer to remove bindings for schedules with state != active. I'll open PR with unit tests.
Maria L: for follow-up: action items — (1) PD override audit entry (chg-4482) recorded, (2) incident ticket INF-2026 created to track postmortem, (3) on-call playbook update noting paused schedule behavior.
Alex R: customer impact note for ops: ~6m of elevated 502s; some customers reported dropped streaming sessions; no data loss. recommend external incident notice? ops-sig?
Samir P: recommend status page note: "partial degradation of inference generation from 06:51-06:58 UTC due to gateway routing and model-proxy instability". I'll draft it.
Irene T: quick triage: root cause candidate A: model-proxy instability (OOM/restarts) B: schedule-syncer race leaving stale bindings. both plausible; will investigate logs + kube events.
Alex R: thanks all. I'll stay on call until PD-78123 is resolved. Maria, if you want to hand off to infra later, coordinate on this thread. :thumbsup:
Maria L: handing to Samir in 30m if stable. posting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-gateway
Samir P: taking over if needed. tagging incident for followup: INF-2026.
Incident Bot: PD-78123 status -> acknowledged -> mitigation in progress (assigned: Maria L).
Alex R: FYI ops rotation owners - please review your schedules for paused-day behavior. Irene, can you add a regression test?
Irene T: will add regression and a canary deploy of the syncer to staging today.
Maria L: closing the loop: PD binding reverted after 30m: command `pd-cli revert-change chg-4482` executed at 07:32:11. monitoring shows stable. reconnecting playbook notes to INF-2026.
Incident Bot: PD-78123 resolved at 07:35:23 UTC.
Alex R: good job. postmortem owners: Maria L (ops lead), Irene T (schedule fix), Samir P (infra lead). next steps doc will include timeline and action items. :white_check_mark:
